description: Extract Notion page body text via Notion's hosted MCP server (OAuth as the signed-in person -- no admin-created integration token needed).

outputs.description: One row per extracted Notion page (doc_id, content, title, url, source_type, updated_at, content_hash), or a MaterializeResult when persist_only/a non-SQL destination is used.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset that will hold the data

oauth_dir.label: Oauth Dir
oauth_dir.description: Directory holding tokens.json + client_info.json from the sign-in CLI (python -m dagster_community_components.resources.notion_mcp_login --oauth-dir <dir>). Treat as a secret -- it grants everything the signed-in person can see in Notion.

root_page_ids.label: Root Page Ids
root_page_ids.description: Notion page ids (or URLs) to crawl as page trees -- each is walked, and any child_page link found while walking its content is recursively walked too, bounded to pages whose ancestor path traces back to one of these roots.

exclude_title_contains.label: Exclude Title Contains
exclude_title_contains.description: Case-insensitive substrings; a page whose title contains any of these is skipped, along with all of its sub-pages (its children are never even visited).

max_pages.label: Max Pages
max_pages.description: Caps how many pages this run emits. Unset: no cap.

max_requests_per_second.label: Max Requests Per Second
max_requests_per_second.description: Shared across every concurrent worker through ONE rate limiter -- a per-worker sleep still exceeds Notion's real aggregate limit (a previously-hit problem). Default 2, below Notion's own ~3 req/s average.

concurrency.label: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of pages crawled in parallel. Default 2 -- paired with max_requests_per_second=2, not a separate per-worker throttle.

max_retries.label: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Retries on Notion's own text-based rate-limit signal (never HTTP 429) or a transient/5xx-shaped error, before failing the run with a clear terminal error.

state_path.label: State Path
state_path.description: Local JSON file tracking {doc_id: {content_hash, updated_at}} across runs, so an unchanged page keeps its prior updated_at instead of bumping it every run. Also used to report how many previously-seen pages fell out of scope this run (pages_pruned metadata) -- actually removing them from a vector store / knowledge graph is prune_missing_sources's job downstream, not this component's. Unset: every page's updated_at is 'now' on every run, and pages_pruned is never computed.

write_disposition.label: Write Disposition
write_disposition.description: dlt write disposition. 'replace' (default): each run fully replaces the table (matches notion_documents's own default and reasoning -- a stale page tree would otherwise just keep accumulating). 'merge': upserts keyed on doc_id. 'append': a historical log of every extraction.

destination.label: Destination
destination.description: dlt destination identifier (e.g. 'snowflake', 'bigquery', 'postgres', 'filesystem', 'duckdb'). Leave empty for in-memory DuckDB -> DataFrame mode.

dataset_name.label: Dataset Name
dataset_name.description: Target dataset/schema in the destination. Defaults to the asset name.

persist_only.label: Persist Only
persist_only.description: If True with destination set: emit a MaterializeResult and skip the DataFrame return.

destination_credentials_url.label: Destination Credentials Url
destination_credentials_url.description: Inline destination connection string. If unset, dlt resolves credentials from env vars.

destination_credentials_env_var.label: Destination Credentials Env Var
destination_credentials_env_var.description: Alternative to destination_credentials_url: env var holding the connection string.

bucket_url.label: Bucket Url
bucket_url.description: Bucket/path URL for filesystem-shaped storage, or the staging area for destination='databricks'/'athena'.

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a sample data preview in metadata

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata.

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: 0 (default): a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows. 1: include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the partitions definition (defaults to UTC).

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Policy Max Partitions Per Run

redact_secrets.label: Redact Secrets
redact_secrets.description: Replace Slack ('xox...'), GitHub ('gh[pousr]_...'), AWS ('AKIA...'), JWT-shaped, and PEM private-key strings found in page content with '[redacted]' before it's hashed or stored -- on by default, since a real runbook page can easily contain a pasted credential. The redaction count is reported as secrets_redacted in materialization metadata.

redact_secrets_extra_patterns.label: Redact Secrets Extra Patterns
redact_secrets_extra_patterns.description: Additional regex patterns (strings) to redact alongside the built-in ones. Only used when redact_secrets is True.

clean_markup.label: Clean Markup
clean_markup.description:
Strip/convert Notion's own markup tags out of page content before it's hashed or stored -- real examples from a live crawl:
, T and T (converted to markdown links [T](url), not dropped), /// (converted to markdown emphasis or plain text), / (removed, keeping their content), //
(converted to 'row: cell \| cell' lines), and / (dropped). On by default -- raw markup otherwise pollutes chunks and the snippets an agent quotes. Applied AFTER the crawl's own child-page discovery, which needs the unmodified / tags to traverse -- this only affects stored content.
